samples.summary: `safeFormat`'s fallback re-throws for the same bad argument, so an untrusted `dp`/`cu` in stored style crashes every render (persistent client-side DoS)
samples.evidence: `safeFormat` (format.ts:14-18) catches a failure from `value.toLocaleString(locale, options)` and retries with `'en-US'` and the *same* `options`. The only errors Intl raises here are argument errors — `RangeError: minimumFractionDigits value is out of range` (dp > 20/100) and `RangeError: Invalid currency code` (a `cu` that is not a well-formed ISO code) — and neither is fixed by changing the locale, so the retry throws again and the RangeError escapes `formatValue`. `formatValue` is called unguarded in the render path (`packages/sheets/src/view/gridcanvas.ts:1596` with `style?.dp` and `currency: style?.cu`, no try/catch) and now also from the new `Sheet.unsetKeepsRendering` (`sheet.ts:4294-4295`, which passes `currency: effective?.cu` straight from stored cell style). Attack: a crafted .xlsx whose `numFmt` code has >20 decimal placeholders reaches `{ nf: 'number', dp: decimalPlaces(...) }` (`packages/sheets/src/import/xlsx-styles.ts:297`) with no upper bound, or a malicious collaborator writes `{nf:'currency', cu:'XX!'}`/`{dp: 300}` into the shared document; every client that renders that cell then throws inside the canvas draw loop and the sheet stops rendering for everyone, persistently, because the bad value is stored. Root cause is pre-existing (the diff relocates the write and adds one new call site), so treat it as a hardening gap this change inherits: `formatValue` should clamp `dp` and validate `cu` (or the fallback should drop the offending option) before handing them to Intl.

samples.summary: `changeDecimals` writes an unbounded `dp` (no clamp on the upper end), letting ordinary toolbar clicks persist a value Intl rejects
samples.evidence: `const stepped = dp + delta` (sheet.ts:4197) is clamped only at zero (`const target = clamped ? 0 : stepped`, 4208-4209) and then persisted verbatim via `setRangeStyle({ dp: target })` (4231-4235). Nothing in the model, the store, or `pruneRedundantDefaultStyleKeys` bounds `dp` (grep for `dp` across packages/sheets/src shows no max), so ~21+ presses of Increase Decimals (or an imported `dp` of 300) stores a value that `formatValue` hands to `Intl` as `minimumFractionDigits`, producing the uncaught RangeError described in the `safeFormat` finding. In a shared Yorkie document the bad `dp` is replicated to every collaborator. Clamping `target` to Intl's legal range (0..20) at the write site would close it.

samples.summary: New public `unsetRangeStyleValues(style)` takes arbitrary keys from its argument with no allow-list against the known `CellStyle` keys before they are used for property access, deletion, and persistence
samples.evidence: `Object.entries(style)` (sheet.ts:4333-4341) is trusted to yield `keyof CellStyle`; the keys then drive `layer[key]` lookups in `verdictFor` (4363) and `delete next[key]` inside `omitStyleKeys` (range-styles.ts:72-74), and the resulting objects are written to the shared store (`setSheetStyle`/`setColumnStyle`/`setRowStyle`/`setRangeStyles`/`set`). I traced the only current caller (`changeDecimals`, sheet.ts:4224-4226) and it passes literal `dp`/`nf`, and I could not build a pollution primitive: the spread `{...style}` defines own properties and `delete` on an own key cannot reach `Object.prototype`, so today this is not exploitable. It is flagged because the method is exported public API on `Sheet` with no key validation, so a future caller that forwards a JSON-parsed patch (import, plugin, collaborative op) would flow attacker-chosen key names into these paths unchecked. Searched: grep for `unsetRangeStyleValues` repo-wide (only `changeDecimals` + tests + docs), read `omitStyleKeys`, `normalizeStylePatch`, `mergeStylePatch` in range-styles.ts for any key allow-listing — none exists.
searchedFor: grep for CellStyle key allow-list / validation helpers

samples.summary: `unsetRangeStyleValues` can strip style keys from a cell outside the selection when a merged block straddles the selection edge
samples.evidence: The cell scan iterates `store.getGrid(range)` for each selected range and maps each hit through `this.normalizeRefToAnchor(parseRef(sref))` (sheet.ts:4407), which resolves a merged-block member to its anchor (`normalizeRefToAnchor` → `getAnchorSrefForRef`, sheet.ts:756-758). When a merged region begins above/left of the selection, that anchor lies outside every `targets` range, yet it is added to `cellEdits` (4425-4428) and written/deleted at 4491-4498 — a write outside the scope the user selected, in a routine whose whole contract is 'only layers the selection owns'. No ownership check (`targets.some(t => containsRange(t, [anchor, anchor]))`) is applied to the anchor. Impact is limited to style keys the caller named, hence minor; I did not construct an end-to-end repro with a straddling merge, hence low confidence.

verdict.reason: Evidence checks out in the repo. format.ts:14-18 catches the Intl failure and retries with the SAME options object (only the locale changes to 'en-US'), so argument-level RangeErrors (fraction digits out of the 0-100 range, invalid currency code) are re-thrown out of formatValue. Untrusted input reaches that argument with no bound: decimalPlaces (xlsx-styles.ts:178-181) returns the raw zero-run length from an attacker-controlled formatCode and is stored as style.dp (xlsx-styles.ts:279/282/297, 413); a `0.` + 101 zeros format code yields dp:101, outside Intl's range. I grepped all of packages/** for any dp clamp (Math.min/Math.max/MAX_DP/clampDecimal) and found none; changeDecimals (sheet.ts:4195-4235) clamps only the 0 floor. The render path is unguarded: gridcanvas.ts:1596 and 1777 call formatValue with style?.dp/style?.cu, and a grep for `try {`/`catch` across the whole gridcanvas.ts returns no matches, so the throw escapes the cell-draw loop; sheet.ts:967, 4294-4295 (new unsetKeepsRendering) and 4719 are likewise unguarded. One claim is narrower than stated: arbitrary `cu` is not reachable from normal typed input (parseCurrency at input.ts:186-206 only maps $/₩ via CurrencySymbolToCode, and import only emits codes from CURRENCY_SYMBOLS at xlsx-styles.ts:170-176), so the invalid-currency variant needs direct document writes. That does not refute the finding because the unbounded dp path from a crafted .xlsx needs no privilege and hits the same unhandled RangeError. Unsafe handling of deserialized untrusted file data producing a persistent unhandled exception in the render loop is in the security lane, and a fallback that reads as a safety net while re-throwing on the same argument is a real weakness. No named refutation ground applies.
